rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + zip, and the agent accessed the correct pending order. However, the agent made a factual error by stating that no size 8 options were available, while the catalog showed an available size 8 synthetic, non‑waterproof variant. More importantly, the agent executed an order modification without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact change—policy requires explicit confirmation before any write. Although the final modification and refund details match the tool outputs, the lack of pre‑write confirmation and the incorrect availability statement violate policy, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
